source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: For each enemy model other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** that a **POXWALKER** model in the unit destroys with an attack, you may bring back one of its destroyed **POXWALKER** models. While **TYPHUS** leads these POXWALKERS, enemy models he kills with his attacks or Eater Plague count as kills by a **POXWALKER** in the unit.

trigger.victim: enemy model other than MONSTER or VEHICLE

optionalReturn.recipient: destroyed POXWALKER model from same unit

typhusException.countsAs: POXWALKER model in this unit for this ability
